title: CentriQ: Calibration-Free Quantization of Diffusion Transformers via Exact Mean Centering
title_zh: CentriQ：通过精确均值中心化实现扩散变换器的无校准量化

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation, but their sampling cost limits deployment. Quantizing both weights and activations to 4 bits reduces this cost, yet existing methods fall short in one of two ways. Calibration-based methods are tied to a specific checkpoint and prompt distribution, whereas data-free Hadamard rotation, effective for LLMs, loses quality on DiTs. We show that this loss has a structural cause. Adaptive layer-norm conditioning adds a per-token mean to the activations, and at the widths of the evaluated DiTs, the Hadamard rotations used by data-free methods cannot spread this mean uniformly across coordinates. A single dominant direction therefore survives the rotation and sets the quantization range. We introduce CentriQ, a calibration-free quantizer that centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 full-precision branch, so that per-token scales follow in closed form without data. Weights are fitted under a robust ℓ p \ell_{p} objective that tracks the dense mode of each group and discounts heavy tails. Across three DiTs, CentriQ matches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant at 4 bits, whereas calibration-free weight quantizers with plain per-token activation quantization collapse or degrade substantially. CentriQ outperforms the strongest calibration-free method reported to date at 2-bit weights. It is also the first calibration-free method to retain usable image quality at 2-bit activations.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器（DiTs）实现了当前最先进的图像生成效果，但其采样成本限制了部署。 将权重和激活值均量化为4位可以降低这一成本，但现有方法在两个方面存在不足。 基于校准的方法依赖于特定的检查点和提示分布，而针对大型语言模型有效的无数据哈达玛旋转方法在DiTs上却会导致质量下降。 我们证明了这种质量损失具有结构性的原因。 自适应层归一化条件会为每个词元添加一个均值到激活值中，而在所评估的DiTs宽度下，无数据方法使用的哈达玛旋转无法将该均值均匀地分布到各个坐标上。 因此，旋转后会保留一个主导方向，并由此确定量化范围。 我们提出了CentriQ——一种无需校准的量化器：它在旋转前对每个词元进行中心化，并通过一个秩为1的全精度分支精确恢复均值，从而无需数据即可以闭式形式计算每个词元的缩放因子。 权重在稳健的ℓ p \ell_{p}目标函数下拟合，该函数可跟踪每个分组的密集模式并抑制重尾效应。 在三种DiTs上，CentriQ在4位量化时与经过校准的SVDQuant质量相当，而采用普通词元激活量化的无校准权重量化器则表现崩溃或显著下降。 在2位权重下，CentriQ的表现优于目前报道的最强无校准方法。 它也是首个能在2位激活值下保持可用图像质量的无校准方法。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) underlie state-of-the-art text-to-image models, but sampling them is expensive. Each image requires many denoising steps, and each step is dominated by the linear layers of the transformer blocks. Unlike autoregressive LLM decoding, which at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, a DiT forward pass is compute-bound. Weight-only quantization (e.g. W4A16) therefore reduces memory but not latency, because the low-bit weights are upcast to 16 bits before the matrix multiply, so activations must be quantized as well.

paragraphs.en: The post-training methods that do reach W4A4 on diffusion models all rely on calibration. A prompt set is run through the model to fit smoothing factors, clipping ranges, rotations, or error-compensating weight updates to the activation statistics of that specific model. SVDQuant ( Li et al., 2025 ) , for instance, migrates activation outliers into the weights using smoothing factors computed from COCO caption prompts, absorbs the magnified weight outliers in a 16-bit low-rank branch, and in its final version also applies GPTQ to the residual.

paragraphs.en: Calibration has costs beyond its compute budget. It makes the quantized model depend on a dataset, it must be repeated for every model, fine-tune, and quantization configuration, and its quality depends on how well the calibration prompts and timesteps match the deployment distribution. Calibration-free methods that reach four-bit activations on image DiTs have appeared only recently (Sec. 2 ), and they evaluate on generation benchmarks that do not measure fidelity to the full-precision model.

First, adaptive layer normalization shifts and rescales every token with conditioning-dependent parameters, so each activation vector carries a per-token mean. paragraphs.en: We present CentriQ, a calibration-free W4A4 post-training quantization method for DiTs that addresses both properties directly. It subtracts the per-token mean before rotation, quantizes only the residual, and restores the mean exactly as a rank-1 term in the layer output, so the quantization range no longer depends on the offset. The centered activation is rotated by a deterministic factorized Hadamard matrix, and weights are quantized to grouped INT4 under a robust ℓ p \ell_{p} ( p < 1 p<1 ) objective, so neither path uses calibration data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 CentriQ，这是一种无需校准的 W4A4 DiTs 后训练量化方法，能够直接解决这两个特性问题。 它在旋转前减去每个标记的均值，仅对残差进行量化，并将均值作为层输出的秩为 1 项精确恢复，因此量化范围不再依赖于偏移量。 中心化的激活值通过一个确定性分解的哈达玛矩阵进行旋转，权重则在稳健的 ℓ p \ell_{p}（p < 1）目标下量化为分组 INT4，因此两条路径均不使用校准数据。

paragraphs.en: We show that adaLN places a per-token mean in DiT activations, which a Hadamard rotation concentrates onto one or a few coordinates that set the quantization range (Figs. 1 and 2 ).

paragraphs.en: Work on U-Net diffusion models showed that activation statistics drift with the timestep ( Li et al., 2023 ; Shang et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ; So et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Methods for diffusion transformers inherit this diagnosis and absorb the drift with calibration: PTQ4DiT ( Wu et al., 2024 ) weights salient channels by timestep, Q-DiT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and ViDiT-Q ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) use dynamic per-timestep or per-token activation scales, DiTAS ( Dong and Zhang, 2025 ) aggregates smoothing factors across timesteps, LRQ-DiT ( Yang et al., 2025 ) chooses rotations per layer from a calibrated metric, and AdaTSQ ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) allocates bit-widths along the trajectory with Fisher-weighted Hessian calibration. The fitted statistics belong to one checkpoint and sampler, so these methods must be refit when the model or guidance changes. Sampler-side corrections ( He et al., 2023 ; Ryu et al., 2026 ) act after quantization and are complementary to any quantizer, whereas training-based approaches ( He et al., 2024 ; Sui et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) fall outside the post-training setting.

paragraphs.en: LLM quantization spreads activation outliers across channels by rotating the residual stream, with random orthogonal matrices in QuIP ( Chee et al., 2023 ) , randomized Hadamard transforms in QuIP# ( Tseng et al., 2024 ) , and Hadamard rotations folded into the weights in QuaRot ( Ashkboos et al., 2024b ) . paragraphs.en: SliceGPT ( Ashkboos et al., 2024a ) and QuaRot fold LayerNorm mean subtraction into the preceding weights, which is exact in LLMs. In a DiT, the adaLN modulation depends on the timestep and prompt and makes the mean vary per token, so this static fold does not apply. HadaNorm ( Federici et al., 2025 ) subtracts a per-channel mean computed over tokens at inference and applies SmoothQuant-style per-channel scales, fitted on a calibration set, before a Hadamard transform, and reports W4A4 on PixArt- Σ \Sigma . CentriQ removes the per-token mean instead and requires no calibration data. To our knowledge, no public implementation of HadaNorm is available, which precludes a direct comparison under our protocol. ConvRot ( Huang et al., 2025 ) spreads the mean with group-wise regular Hadamard transforms of order 4 k 4^{k} , which mix only within each group, whereas CentriQ removes the mean and mixes globally with factorized Hadamard matrices.

paragraphs.en: SVDQuant ( Li et al., 2025 ) was the first to reach reasonable 4-bit weights and activations on image DiTs, by keeping a low-rank branch in 16 bits after SmoothQuant-style migration ( Xiao et al., 2023 ) fit on captioned images, with fused kernels in Nunchaku. DiRotQ ( Sharify et al., 2026 ) preserves a calibration-derived PCA subspace of the activations at higher precision and quantizes weights with GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) , improving over SVDQuant on PixArt- Σ \Sigma under the MJHQ-30K protocol, which is not directly comparable with the MJHQ-5k protocol used here. HQ-DiT ( Liu and Zhang, 2024 ) reaches 4-bit operands with a floating-point grid.
paragraphs.zh: SVDQuant（Li 等人，2025）首次实现了图像 DiT 模型中合理的 4 位权值和激活值：在通过 SmoothQuant 风格迁移（Xiao 等人，2023）对带注释图像进行适配后，保留一个低秩分支以 16 位表示，并使用 Nunchaku 中的融合内核。 DiRotQ（Sharify 等人，2026）以更高精度保留了通过校准得到的激活值的主成分分析子空间，并使用 GPTQ（Frantar 等人，2023）对权值进行量化，在 PixArt-ΣΣ 数据集上基于 MJHQ-30K 协议的表现优于 SVDQuant；但该协议与本文使用的 MJHQ-5k 协议并不直接可比。 HQ-DiT（Liu 和 Zhang，2024）通过浮点网格实现了 4 位操作数。

paragraphs.en: On the weight side, RTN, NF4 ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) , HQQ ( Badri and Shaji, 2023 ) , and SINQ ( Müller et al., 2026 ) operate on the weight tensor alone. NF4 assumes near-Gaussian weights, HQQ fits the dense mode under an ℓ p \ell_{p} objective with p < 1 p<1 , and SINQ balances a second scale axis with Sinkhorn iterations. Calibration-free 4-bit activations on DiTs are recent. DVD-Quant ( Li et al., 2026 ) achieves W4A4 for video DiTs with grid refinement, rotated quantization, and adaptive bit switching. ConvRot achieves it on FLUX-family models with group-wise rotation, NVFP4 weights, and per-tensor FP8 activation scales. OrbitQuant ( Lee et al., 2026 ) quantizes weights and activations in a randomly permuted block-Hadamard basis with a Lloyd–Max codebook derived from the post-rotation marginal ( Zandieh et al., 2026 ) , and reports GenEval on FLUX.1 and Z-Image-Turbo down to W2A4. Neither image method removes the token mean, both mix within blocks whose order divides the width, and both evaluate on generation benchmarks that do not measure fidelity to the full-precision model.

paragraphs.en: CentriQ is calibration-free on both axes and produces integer W4A4 operands for every transformer-block projection. We evaluate it on PixArt- Σ \Sigma , FLUX.1-schnell, and SANA-1.6B with FID, ImageReward, LPIPS, and PSNR against the 16-bit reference on MJHQ, and compare against the published results of calibrated SVDQuant. To our knowledge it is the first calibration-free integer W4A4 method evaluated for fidelity across three image-DiT architecture families.

The inner loop refits ( 𝐳 g , Q g ) (\mathbf{z}_{g},Q_{g}) on the preconditioned tile W g / 𝐬 W_{g}/\mathbf{s} by half-quadratic splitting, where an auxiliary residual E g E_{g} decouples the ℓ p \ell_{p} term from the reconstruction,

paragraphs.en: We measure the latency of CentriQ at W4A4 on FLUX.1-schnell on a single A100-80GB GPU at 1024 × \times 1024 resolution and 4 4 denoising steps. paragraphs.en: The per-token mean that CentriQ removes originates in the adaLN modulation, which all three conditioning designs share, so one activation path transfers across PixArt- Σ \Sigma , FLUX.1-schnell, and SANA-1.6B without per-model tuning. By Lemma 1 , none of the evaluated DiT widths admits a rotation that spreads this component uniformly, which makes explicit mean removal the direct remedy for Hadamard-based activation quantization in these models. Because the centered, rotated token contains no term that depends on the row sums of the rotation (Eq. ( 10 ), App. C.5 ), a single clip percentile, fixed once for all models and layers, reaches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant in Tab. 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个标记的平均值意味着 CentriQ 所移除的部分源于 adaLN 调制，而三种条件设计均共享该调制，因此一条激活路径无需针对各模型单独调优即可在 PixArt-Σ \Sigma、FLUX.1-schnell 和 SANA-1.6B 之间传递。根据引理 1，所有评估的 DiT 宽度都不存在能将此组件均匀分布的旋转方式，这使得显式移除平均值成为这些模型中基于 Hadamard 矩阵的激活量化的直接解决方案。由于经过中心化与旋转的标记不包含任何依赖于旋转行和的项（公式 (10)，附录 C.5），因此只需为所有模型和层固定一个剪辑百分位数，即可达到表 1 中校准 SVDQuant 的质量水平。

paragraphs.en: We showed that adaptive layer normalization places a per-token mean in DiT activations, which a Hadamard rotation concentrates onto a few coordinates that dominate the quantization range. CentriQ centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 term, which makes the quantization range independent of the rotation, and it quantizes weights under a robust ℓ p \ell_{p} objective, so no step requires calibration data. At W4A4, CentriQ matches calibrated SVDQuant on all three models, and its centering and rotation add no net latency over BF16 inference. On FLUX.1-schnell, it also retains usable image quality at W2A4 and extends calibration-free quantization to 2-bit activations. A fused kernel for 2-bit activations and an extension to video diffusion transformers are natural next steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了自适应层归一化会在 DiT 激活值中为每个词元引入一个均值，而哈达玛旋转会将该均值集中到少数几个主导量化范围的坐标上。 CentriQ 在旋转前对每个词元进行中心化，并通过一个秩为 1 的项精确恢复均值，这使得量化范围与旋转无关；同时，它基于稳健的 ℓ p \ell_{p} 目标对权重进行量化，因此无需任何校准数据。 在 W4A4 配置下，CentriQ 在所有三种模型上的表现均与经过校准的 SVDQuant 相当，且其中心化和旋转操作相较于 BF16 推理并未增加净延迟。 在 FLUX.1-schnell 模型上，它在 W2A4 配置下仍能保持可用的图像质量，并将无校准量化扩展到了 2 位激活值。 为 2 位激活值设计融合内核，并将其扩展到视频扩散变换器，是顺理成章的后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: Fidelity metrics measure agreement with the 16-bit output, not whether the quantized model still follows the prompt. We therefore evaluate compositional generation on FLUX.1-schnell with GenEval (Tab. 5 ). For completeness, the table also includes results reported by the concurrent preprint OrbitQuant ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . At W4A4, CentriQ preserves prompt adherence: its Overall score of 0.670 matches BF16 (0.667) and is close to our calibrated SVDQuant reproduction (0.682), although OrbitQuant and AdaTSQ score higher. Below four bits, the comparison favors CentriQ. At W2A4, the rotation and smoothing baselines collapse to near-zero scores, whereas CentriQ reaches 0.647, ahead of OrbitQuant (0.604) on every sub-task except Colors. At W4A2, CentriQ retains 0.573 and is the only calibration-free method reported in this regime. Because W2A4 outperforms W4A2 on every sub-task, activation precision limits compositional quality more than weight precision does, which supports the emphasis of Sec. 4 on the activation quantizer.
paragraphs.zh: 保真度指标衡量的是与 16 位输出的吻合程度，而非量化模型是否仍然遵循提示。 因此，我们使用 GenEval（表 5）在 FLUX.1-schnell 上评估组合生成能力。 为求完整，该表还包含了同期预印本 OrbitQuant（Lee 等人，2026）报告的结果。 在 W4A4 条件下，CentriQ 保持了提示遵循性：其总体得分为 0.670，与 BF16（0.667）一致，且接近我们经过校准的 SVDQuant 复现结果（0.682），尽管 OrbitQuant 和 AdaTSQ 的得分更高。 在低于 4 位的条件下，CentriQ 的表现更优。 在 W2A4 条件下，旋转和平滑基线方法的得分接近于零，而 CentriQ 达到了 0.647，在除“颜色”外的所有子任务上均优于 OrbitQuant（0.604）。 在 W4A2 条件下，CentriQ 保持了 0.573 的得分，也是该区间内唯一报告的不需校准的方法。 由于 W2A4 在所有子任务上的表现均优于 W4A2，激活精度对组合生成质量的影响大于权重精度，这支持了第 4 节对激活量化器的强调。

paragraphs.en: The paper specifies every component needed to reimplement CentriQ. Sec. 4.2 and App. B.1 define the centering, the factorized Hadamard rotation, the padding rule, and the closed-form per-token scale, and Sec. 4.3 and App. B.3 give the ℓ p \ell_{p} objective, the solver, and all hyperparameters, which are shared across models and layers (Tab. 3 ). App. B.2 describes how the rank-1 term and the zero-point correction are fused into the Nunchaku 4-bit GEMM. All models, prompt sets (MJHQ-5k, sDCI, GenEval), and metrics are public, and App. A lists the samplers, step counts, guidance scales, seeding protocol, and the Nunchaku release used for SVDQuant.
paragraphs.zh: 本文详细说明了重新实现 CentriQ 所需的所有组件。第 4.2 节和附录 B.1 定义了中心化、分解形式的哈达玛旋转、填充规则以及每个标记的闭式缩放；第 4.3 节和附录 B.3 则给出了 ℓ p \ell_{p} 目标函数、求解器以及所有超参数，这些参数在所有模型和层之间共享（见表格 3）。附录 B.2 描述了如何将秩为 1 的项和零点校正融合到 Nunchaku 4-bit GEMM 中。所有模型、提示集（MJHQ-5k、sDCI、GenEval）和评估指标均已公开，附录 A 列出了用于 SVDQuant 的采样器、步数、引导缩放、种子设置协议以及所使用的 Nunchaku 版本。

paragraphs.en: CentriQ lowers the cost of running text-to-image models, which widens access for legitimate uses and for misuse alike. The quantized models inherit the safety behavior and biases of their 16-bit sources, and this work does not evaluate either. We collected no new data and ran no studies with human participants. All prompt sets come from public benchmarks and are used under their respective licenses.
